rashifal.theme: .input {$house :integer} .match $house 1 {{your energy and confidence}} 2 {{savings and speech}} 3 {{courage, siblings and short trips}} 4 {{home and peace of mind}} 5 {{study, children and ideas}} 6 {{competition, debts and routine}} 7 {{your partner and partnerships}} 8 {{the unexpected}} 9 {{luck, faith and teachers}} 10 {{work and standing}} 11 {{income, gains and friends}} 12 {{spending, rest and distant travel}} * {{your energy and confidence}}

frame.FIRST_HALF: The first half of the month
